question: What are TwinkleofToes's current abilities that have fear effects?
notes: Store-only case (live-session intake, 2026-11-01): fear = exact Fear keyword token in abilities.keywords intersected with TwinkleofToes sheet Skills[*].Abilities (2026-11-01 17:01Z). Oracle correction: Smell Fear (Werewolf) matched LIKE '%Fear%' via the SmellFear substring but carries no Fear token and no flee text, so it is excluded. Confirmed via SpecialInfo flee text: Cause Terror / Terrifying Bite / Squeal force flee for 5s; Horrifying Screech carries the Fear token. Loop baseline (6 rounds): kept only Cause Terrors, dropped the other 3 retrieved facts, invented Fast Talk/Mock/Ridicule/Strike a Nerve/Tell Me About Your Mother/Soothe/Grunt of Abeyance (zero Fear tokens). A run without the named character defaulted to EclipsiavonLuna and hallucinated ability IDs, so the question names TwinkleofToes.
